content: Reproducible academic/solo data-science project structure: strict separation between src/ (importable, tested logic) and notebooks/ (orchestration + narrative for the thesis write-up); notebooks should call functions from src/ rather than contain business logic, since notebook diffs/merges are unreliable for version control. Raw data is read-only; every transformation writes to a new directory/table rather than mutating in place, so the full pipeline can be re-run end-to-end from data/raw. A config module centralizes paths/thresholds/hyperparameters instead of hardcoding them across notebooks. The project should be self-contained enough that a third party (thesis committee) could clone the repo and reproduce all figures/results from src/ + a data snapshot.
